answer: One defence is Proof of unique eye test record with optician attestation: tests the optician recorded across years of patients, and the ridge of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: tests the optician recorded across years of patients is fresh per account, and the reef is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the glacier of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
